svg.title: Choose the dataflow for the workload
svg.desc: Systolic MAC arrays exploit weight reuse across tokens or batches. TriXium targets batch-1 decode with ternary weight streams, sign selection and adder trees, plus programmable layer operations. These are workload-specific trade-offs, not a universal performance ranking.

g.text: Choose the dataflow for the workload
Weight reuse and memory bandwidth shape the architecture
More reuse can keep more arithmetic busy.
Size parallelism to the memory stream.
Serial work still contributes to token time.
Different workloads reward different dataflows. See the architecture document for limits and numerical formats.
